- **p2:** the confirm dialog of an irreversible action is titled 「确认操作」 with a neutral 「继续」. Pass the action's own label and its danger variant through `ActionRunner`'s `ConfirmationHandler` to `ActionConfirmDialog` (the title is the action label, the confirm button takes the label in the danger style). ⛔ No new authorable key: the action already declares its label and variant.

Claim amendment · seat `domain:ui#4` · `session_01QsR2jTfvjNTaR29ehLk26T` · 2026-10-27T11:20Z

File surface (replaces the claim's line): `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` (the confirm call site only), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionConfirmDialog.tsx` if needed, `ui/scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs` (four JUSTIFIED table entries only: `action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group` and `action:menu` do not forward `variant`), their tests, one root changeset (stop on breach; explain in the report)

Why: once the runner reads the action's declared `variant`, the forward-parity gate expects the four action renderers to forward it too. Their own `variant` is the `@object-ui/types` UIActionSchema control vocabulary (`destructive`, `outline`, …), consumed at the renderer to paint its control. `ActionDef.variant` is the spec enum (`danger`, `link`, …). Forwarding one into the other is a type error. Each entry names the reason and this card. Whether the two vocabularies should be reconciled is a separate question; it comes back in the report's open questions, ⛔ not built here.
